title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag - Last Place Punishment
description:
Loud, proud, and merciless—in the best good-natured way. This direct punishment flag is designed for adult fantasy-football leagues who want a bold, funny reminder of last-place glory at draft parties, end-of-season gatherings, toilet-bowl fines, or office desks.

Design details (printed exactly as shown):
- Eyebrow: LAST PLACE CERTIFIED
- Printed phrase lines: "I SUCK AT" / "FANTASY" / "FOOTBALL"
- Footer: ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE
- Treatment: dark green sports scoreboard look — big block type, high contrast, loud and embarrassing

Product facts (verified):
- Double-sided: message prints on both sides
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor use
- Printed to order
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included

Made with AI-assisted layout/listing work and produced in partnership with GreenLine Printworks. Your flag will be printed to order by our production partner and inspected before shipping.

Perfect for: draft day humiliation, end-of-season ceremonies, toilet-bowl consequences, league parties, or as a gag gift to make the loser wear—or wave—their mistakes. Use it at a watch party, on the mantle, in the office, or hung outside the house for maximum league-wide proof of failure.

Note: This listing describes the printed design and verified product details above. Flagpole and mounting hardware are sold separately or may be sourced locally.
